if not SMOKE:   # FF variant guard (CHANGES.md): dry run of lora_data before training, no weights touched
        print("[cell] FF dry check: LoRA C1 clip list (expected 210 clips, 70 persons, all MAV-Celeb v1, 0 VoxCeleb2)", flush=True)
        _ff_src = '''import collections, json, sys, types, importlib.util
train, bundle, lid, cache, mav, out = sys.argv[1:7]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("rfs_train_ff_drycheck", train)
R = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(R)
E, _ = R.load_bundle(bundle)
a = types.SimpleNamespace(lid=lid, cache=cache, mav=mav)
wavs, pid, names = R.lora_data(E, R.read_lid(a), a, cap=None)
key = lambda k: k[0] + ":" + (k[1].split("_")[0] if k[0] == "mav" else "-")
inv = {j: k for k, j in names.items()}
got = {"clips": len(wavs), "persons": len(names), "clips_by_source": dict(collections.Counter(key(inv[int(j)]) for j in pid)),
       "persons_by_source": dict(collections.Counter(key(k) for k in names))}
exp = {"clips": 210, "persons": 70, "clips_by_source": {"mav:v1": 210}, "persons_by_source": {"mav:v1": 70}}
ok = got == exp
json.dump({"ok": ok, "mav_root": mav, "expected": exp, "got": got}, open(out, "w"), indent=1)
print("FF lora dry check:", "OK" if ok else "MISMATCH", json.dumps(got), flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 3)
'''
        _ff_dry = WORK / "ff_lora_drycheck.py"; _ff_dry.write_text(_ff_src, encoding="utf-8")
        _ff_p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-u", str(_ff_dry), str(TRAIN), str(BUNDLE), LID, str(tars[0].parent.parent), str(mav), str(W / "ff_lora_drycheck.json")], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)

THE KEY BUG IS KEPT ON PURPOSE: embedded rfs_train.py (sha256 98aa07ae..., original/decoded/train/rfs_train.py line 406) looks the VoxCeleb2 clips up in the audio cache with (v_spk, v_vid, v_utt) where v_vid = 'spk/video' while the cache stores the bare video, so 0 VoxCeleb2 clips match; only MAV clips are learned. This IS the 13.54 variant (DESIGN 2.7). Do not run the current Experiment/RFS-01/train/rfs_train.py (RFS_LORA_FIX defaults to 1 there, line 959).

Data actually learned: 210 MAV-Celeb v1 clips (centre 3 s of the wav, at most 3 videos per person) of the 70 v1 persons, face anchor = mean unit ImageBind face (f_ibf) per person from the bundle; v4: the 6 485 train wavs are only embedded (v_lora), not learned. The audio cache, MAV v2 and VoxCeleb2 are mounted but contribute nothing (v2: wav paths do not resolve under the v1 parent folder; VoxCeleb2: key bug).

MAV mount: keep the two parent folders mavceleb_v1_complete-001/v1 and mavceleb_v2_complete-002/v2 (DESIGN 4.1); merging v1 and v2 under one parent would make the code learn v2 too (the dry check then fails).

Bundle input (wiring, fixer 18/11): the repo's t163l_orig reads the bundle made by t163b (FLAG_163 B version 5, assemble.py b46dd180, v4.npz f_xf 4 096 columns); the original L run (pushed 2026-11-04 00:37, kapi_runs line 1315) read the earlier bundle of B version 4 (assemble.py 432bdbf9, embedded in the L notebook, keeps the 4 097 / 193-column CSV cut); B was re-pushed at 02:10 (line 1327). The two assemble.py differ only in lines 71-74 (rd() column cut of the v4 CSVs, i.e. v4.npz f_xf / v_xv). Mode L reads ext.npz (lora_data, face_by_person; same code and inputs in both versions), V4 v_path (v_lora) and the presence of f_age (present in both, so the age branch is not taken): no effect on lora_C1.pt or v4_extra.npz.

Runner smoke (FF_SMOKE=1) of this stage is a real-data mini run (smoke_env RFS_LORA_STEPS=3, RFS_LORA_BATCH=4, RFS_LORA_CAP=16; FLAG_SMOKE is not set): ImageBind is downloaded and hash-checked, the dry check runs on the full data, v_lora is computed for the 6 485 v4 wavs. Its post_check ff_lora_meta.json fails by construction (3 steps), which is not fatal in smoke.
LoRA C1 policy (fixer 18/11, ../README.md): force_only; consumers read the saved original with resolve saved_only.

runner_requirements.why: mode L: rfs_train.py lora gets --bundle / --lid / --cache / --mav / --v4root / --ib_ckpt as arguments and the dry-check subprocess the same paths; the decoded rfs_train.py (98aa07ae) contains no /kaggle path (grep); all lookups are in the stage text

FF_FORCE=t163l_orig re-runs the recipe as a provenance check, accepted on ff_lora_drycheck.json (210 clips / 70 persons / all mav:v1) + ff_lora_meta.json (48 params, 1200 steps, batch 64, 210 clips, 70 persons, 0 skipped); the C1 consumers keep reading the saved file (resolve saved_only)
